title: River Valleys and the Foundations of Civilizations (Day 88)
description: Examine how geographic indicators accelerated early settlement infrastructure growth.
concept: Stable water resources enabled structural shifts from migratory to agricultural societies.
bullets: Silt distribution networks created highly fertile farming basins.
Irrigation infrastructure developments generated early municipal laws.
Trade routes linked isolated settlements into broad economic grids.
cross_reference: Proverbs 22:28 — Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
